notes: The source leaves the material/section appendix unspecified. Frozen author choice: one idealized linear-elastic steel material, E=206000 MPa, nu=0.30, G=E/[2(1+nu)], rho=7850 kg/m3; solid rectangular roof section 0.30 m by 0.60 m, column section 0.50 m by 0.50 m, and, where present, mezzanine section 0.25 m by 0.50 m. Tabulated A/Iy/Iz/J are explicit inputs.

Member axes: local 1 is i-to-j, local 2 is global +Y, and local 3 is local 1 cross local 2. In-plane bending is M2. Euler-Bernoulli kinematics include axial deformation but exclude shear deformation. Unspecified node displacements mean both in-plane translations ux/uz; base reactions include in-plane force components Fx/Fz and moment My.
Load case D contains the stated simultaneously applied loads with unit factors. It does not add self-weight. No additional load combinations are supplied.
The left column is split at the 3 m mezzanine connection. The 6 m cantilever free end has no in-plane restraints.
